QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 2
QuestInfo.2: Rain's question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.

0.0: Alright, talk to me when you're ready for the next question.

1.0:
Can you wear an item just by double-clicking it with your mouse? 

#L0##bOh yes#l
#L1#No way.#k#l
1.1: Yup, you can wear an item just by double-clicking it from your inventory. If you can't wear something, check that your character meets the level and statistic requirements.

0.1: Try it! Press E, then take off an item by double-clicking it. Then, double-click the item from the item inventory (in case you forgot, press I) to put it back on.
